sections.heading: Recording
body: Tap Start when you set off. Scout writes a FIT file on this device — no account needed.
Pause stops GPS and radar to save battery. Stop finishes the file and saves it under Settings.

sections.heading: Tagging
body: Tap a tile to stamp hazards, closures, surfaces and resupply onto your GPS track.
Tap the same tile again within a few seconds to undo.
Surface mode keeps tagging until you tap END on the banner or the END tile.

sections.heading: Radar (optional)
body: Pair a rear radar under Settings. It connects when you Start and disconnects on Pause or Stop.
Overtakes are stored in the FIT file like everything else. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

sections.heading: Your ride file
body: Finished rides stay on this device until you delete them. Share the FIT to any app.

sections.heading: Permissions
body: Location (precise): records your GPS track and where each tag lands.
Notifications: the ongoing ride indicator while a session is open.
Nearby devices: only for pairing a BLE radar — tagging works without it.
Change these anytime in Android Settings → Apps → Scout → Permissions.

sections.heading: Sharing (optional)
body: This build can send a finished ride to your Atlas instance as a private draft.
Preview it on the web before you submit it for curation. The app cannot publish for you.
Copy help/help.example.json to help/help.json and edit this section for your instance.

sections.heading: Source code
body: Scout is open source (MIT). Point this link at your fork's repository.
